title: Navier-Stokes Regularity
exact_target: Do smooth three-dimensional incompressible fluid data always give global smooth solutions, or can admissible data and forcing prevent this? The official problem allows an answer either in Euclidean space or on the periodic three-torus.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1318 (ANA-006). CC BY 4.0.

Charles L. Fefferman, \emph{Existence and Smoothness of the Navier--Stokes Equation}, official Clay Mathematics Institute problem description, pp. 1--2, equations (1)--(11), alternatives (A)--(D), and appended errata.
